messages.ko: 오늘 넥스트 생일이잖아~~~ 많이 축하해줘서 고마워 작년 이맘때쯤 나는 내가 공개된걸보고 설렘반 두려움반 두근두근했었던거같아 내가 데뷔라니!! 이런마음에 꿈인가 현실인가 오히려 무덤덤했었을수도 있어 ㅎㅎ 팬분들을 처음만날때도 프롬을 처음시작할때도 너무 서투르고 어색해서 뚝딱거렸을텐데 웨이브가 오히려 내 긴장을 풀어줬어 많이 부족했던 1년전 하연이를 좋아해줘서 고맙고 조금이지만 성장해있는 지금의 나도 좋아해줘서 고마워 우리의 사이가 1년이라도 깊어졌다는 사실이 너무 좋다 두서없이 내 마음을 표현하다보니 전달이 잘 안될수도 있지만 내맘 알거라고 생각해~~😘지금의 나를 있게 만들어줘서 고마워
messages.en: Today is NXT's birthday~~~ Thank you so much for congratulating me. Around this time last year, I was half excited and half scared to see myself revealed. 'I'm debuting!!' With those feelings I wondered if it was a dream or reality, and I might have even been numb about itㅎㅎ. When I first met the fans and when I first started Fromm, I was so awkward and clumsy, but WAV helped me ease my tension. Thank you for liking the Hayeon from a year ago who was lacking in many ways, and thank you for liking the current me who has grown, even if just a little. I'm so happy that our bond has grown deeper over this past year. I tend to ramble when expressing my feelings, so maybe it doesn't come across perfectly, but I think you know how I feel~~😘 Thank you for making me who I am today.
And Christmas is coming soon, right?
You didn't cry too much this year, right?
If there were many tears this year, I hope there won't be any more.

messages.ko: 나쁜산타는 우는사람한테 엄격하지만 착한산타는 그런건 신경안쓴데
messages.en: Bad Santa is strict with people who cry, but Good Santa doesn't care about that.
I guess I'm a good Santa.

messages.ko: 1년전 하연이는 나를 좋아해주는 이렇게 많은 사람들이 생길거라곤 상상도 못했겠지만 너의 주변엔 이렇게 좋은사람들이 많이 생겼다는걸 1년전 하연이한테 말해주고싶넹
messages.en: The Hayeon from a year ago would've never imagined that so many people would come to like me, but I'd love to tell the Hayeon from a year ago that there would be so many wonderful people around her.
Let's make this our 1st anniversary commemorative photo.
A celebration of how much I've grown.
Let's have a happy end of the year.
